units.source_text: 这个叶子姑娘的弟弟，从今冬起就在这个将要被大雪覆盖的铁路信号所工作。

en.t: The younger brother of this girl Yoko had started working this winter at this railway signal station, which would soon be covered in heavy snow.

units.source_text: 岛村知道这一情况以后，对她越发感兴趣了。

en.t: After Shimamura learned this, he became even more interested in her.
